chunks: Ya'qub ibn Shu'ayb asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man: may he ride his hady if he needs it? So he said:
“The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said: ‘He may ride it without overstraining it and without exhausting it.’”

key_terms.هَدْيَهُ: his sacrificial animal designated for offering in hajj

ai.seo_question: Can a person ride his sacrificial animal during hajj if he needs to?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the sacrificial animal in hajj. It permits riding the hady when there is need, provided the animal is not overburdened or exhausted, reflecting care for the sacrificial animal while allowing necessary benefit.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3086 - Ya'qub ibn Shu'ayb asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a man—can he ride his hady (sacrificial animal) if he needs to?
Imam (as) replied: "The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said: 'He may ride it as long as he does not overburden or exhaust it.'"
